title: Recorded starlette pack

candidates.claim: method-call-signature: `client.get(...)`: no parameter named 'headers'; no package method 'get' accepts it (e.g. Config.get at starlette/config.py:94)
candidates.reason: TestClient inherits httpx's client API, where request methods such as get accept a `headers` argument.

candidates.claim: The WebSocket documentation calls `receive_json` with a positional `data` argument, but the implementation only accepts `mode`.
candidates.reason: The documented call passes a positional `data` argument, but `WebSocket.receive_json` accepts only `mode`.

candidates.claim: method-call-signature: `websocket.receive_json(...)`: keyword 'mode' would also be filled positionally (multiple values); no package method 'receive_json' accepts it (e.g. WebSocketTestSession.receive_json at starlette/testclient.py:188)
candidates.reason: The WebSocket test session's `receive_json` also accepts only `mode` and has no `data` parameter.
